The Flames standard · four stages, every chair

One cut. Four stages.

Same order, same care, whether it's your first visit or your fiftieth. That's how a 4.9 stays a 4.9.

01

Consult

Tell us the shape, the length, the photo on your phone. We listen before the clippers come out.

02

Cut

Fade, taper, scissor work. Blended slow, checked from every angle.

03

Line-up

Hairline, temples, beard. Edges sharp enough to notice across the room.

04

Finish

Hot towel, product, mirror check. You leave when it's right, not when the timer runs out.
